title: Idle Runescape-style RPG
author: Accurate-Bear7198
selftext:
I always enjoyed playing idle games like Rusty's Retirement, just something to have on the side while i'm working, see progression over time, and intervene whenever i felt like it, but wasn't completely necessary. There is a game like Idle RPG, but its too much manual intervention, not what i really wanted and not truly idle...

  
I always loved OSRS, and there was no true idle rpg game like that, so I made one. Its basically like an idle oldschool runescape style game, where you rebuild the town, watch heroes arrive through fame from building up the town, they gather resources, craft their own gear, level, form parties/clans, do dungeons together, fight bosses, do quests, etc. I know its not perfect yet, but the idea is there 

  
Having something like this has always been a dream of mine, the rewarding progression of runescape, but the idle gameplay of games like Rusty's Retirement is something I always wanted, and now i've made it. Down to the nostalgic 16 bit sounds/music to the gameplay/mechanics.

  
Is this something other people would enjoy? And is there any recommendations to how an idle game should actually perform? It's my first time

comments.author: MiamiStarz
